name: InspectorDropdown
label: Inspector dropdown
description: One-row select for inspector panels, with the name inside the bar and the library Dropdown's menu and font previews.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting's name, drawn inside the bar on the left. Also the dropdown's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description:
Currently selected value, controlled. Leave undefined to let the
dropdown keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected value on first render when uncontrolled (`value` undefined).

props.name: options
props.description: Available options (flat list). Each option's `font` previews the face, as in Dropdown.

props.name: groups
props.description: Optional grouped options. When provided, renders groups with labels and separators.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the right when nothing is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size, matching Button: `default` is 40px tall, `compact` 32px.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the wrapper.
